scripts.name: which one-liner — interpreters + net (Linux)
scripts.body: which python python2 python3 perl ruby php php7 php8 lua lua5.1 node nodejs go gcc java bash sh zsh nc ncat netcat socat curl wget openssl ssh telnet awk 2>/dev/null

scripts.name: command -v — interpreters & shells (Linux, portable)
scripts.body:
# Works even where 'which' is missing. Prints only what exists, with its path.
for b in sh bash dash zsh ksh ash busybox \
         python python2 python3 \
         perl ruby php php7 php8 lua lua5.1 lua5.3 tclsh expect \
         node nodejs deno \
         gcc cc g++ clang make \
         go rustc java javac \
         awk gawk mawk sed; do
  p=$(command -v "$b" 2>/dev/null) && printf '%-10s %s\n' "$b" "$p"
done

scripts.name: command -v — networking & transfer tools (Linux)
scripts.body:
# Binaries handy for reverse shells, tunnelling and exfil.
for b in nc ncat netcat nc.traditional nc.openbsd socat \
         curl wget \
         ssh scp sftp telnet ftp \
         openssl stunnel \
         rlwrap script \
         base64 xxd od \
         mkfifo mknod \
         tcpdump nmap ping; do
  p=$(command -v "$b" 2>/dev/null) && printf '%-14s %s\n' "$b" "$p"
done

scripts.name: Full binary recon — one pass (Linux)
scripts.body:
# Everything at once: which language/shell/net binary is present.
for b in sh bash dash zsh ksh ash busybox \
         python python2 python3 perl ruby php lua lua5.1 tclsh expect \
         node nodejs deno gcc cc g++ clang make go rustc java javac \
         awk gawk mawk sed \
         nc ncat netcat nc.traditional socat \
         curl wget ssh scp sftp telnet ftp openssl \
         rlwrap base64 xxd mkfifo mknod tcpdump nmap; do
  p=$(command -v "$b" 2>/dev/null) && printf '  [+] %-14s %s\n' "$b" "$p"
done
echo '--- done ---'

scripts.name: where — interpreters & tools (Windows CMD)
scripts.body:
:: 'where' searches PATH and prints the full path, or nothing (errors hidden).
@echo off
for %%b in (python.exe python3.exe py.exe perl.exe ruby.exe php.exe ^
            powershell.exe pwsh.exe cscript.exe wscript.exe mshta.exe ^
            node.exe java.exe ^
            nc.exe ncat.exe netcat.exe socat.exe ^
            curl.exe wget.exe certutil.exe bitsadmin.exe ^
            ssh.exe openssl.exe) do @where %%b 2>nul
